insert.if: INSERT INTO RAIN_HIST (AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE, RAIN_DATE, RAIN) VALUES (#{area_code}, #{type}, #{where_date}, #{rain})
INSERT INTO TEMP_HIST (AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE, TEMP_DATE, AVR_VAL) VALUES (#{area_code}, #{type}, #{where_date}, #{rain})
INSERT INTO WIND_HIST (AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE, WIND_DATE, AVR_DEG1) VALUES (#{area_code}, #{type}, #{where_date}, #{rain})
INSERT INTO WIND_HIST (AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE, WIND_DATE, AVR_VEL1) VALUES (#{area_code}, #{type}, #{where_date}, #{rain})
INSERT INTO HUMI_HIST (AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE, HUMI_DATE, AVR_VAL) VALUES (#{area_code}, #{type}, #{where_date}, #{rain})

choose.when: SELECT IFNULL(AVR_VEL1, -99999) AS RAIN, IFNULL(AVR_DEG1, -99999) AS RAIN_D, WIND_DATE AS RAIN_DATE FROM WIND_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} AND WIND_DATE between #{sdate} and #{edate} ORDER BY WIND_DATE
